skill_name: Write a short story beginning with "The sun had already set in the west when..."
workflow: The sun had already set in the west when the old man noticed a light in the distance. As he got closer, he saw that the light was coming from a small cabin tucked away in the trees. He approached the cabin, curious as to who would be living there. When the man knocked on the door, the door opened and a young woman stepped outside. She had long black hair and a big smile.
